mapper.insert: insert into book(book_name, cover, author, book_tag_id, grade, unit_name, description) value(#{bookName},#{cover},#{author},#{bookTagId},#{grade},#{unitName},#{description})
mapper.update: update book set chapter_count=chapter_count+1 where id=#{bookId}
update book set chapter_count=chapter_count-1 where id=#{bookId} and chapter_count > 0
